main_measure.name: mean 20-bar forward return on short bars minus on all bars (pp)
main_measure.threshold: confirm if at most -2 percentage points with t at or below -2; reject if 0 or positive

supporting_check.name: hit rate of negative 20-bar returns, short bars minus all bars (pp)

decided_by: Reject: the short-bar hit rate is not above the unconditional share.
reading: Short bars are grid bars (positions 0, 20, 40, ... of each window, with a full 20-bar forward return inside the window) whose forecast is below 0, compared against all grid bars of the same windows, and the largest-tertile shorts are the ceil(n/3) short cases with the most negative forecast.
